$description: Theme: soft, dark — Agent Comms' own until cue-ui ships its soft preset (cue-ui-82). A near-black page, three soft surface steps, a cool grey ink ladder and a violet-blue accent. COLOR ONLY.

$extensions.com.cueplusplus.provenance: The approved mockup for Agent Comms 0.28.0 (the desktop design 2026-10-24, §8 and §9; files kept at ~/work/cue++/backups/agentcomms-0.28-mockup-2026-10-25/Main.dc.html), and cue-ui-82, which lists its values. bg, the three surfaces, the three inks, the accent and ok, warn and danger are the mockup's; accent-fg is its accentText and focus its ring colour without the alpha.
$extensions.com.cueplusplus.adjustments: fg-subtle is #8E8E97, not the mockup's #8B8B94, so it reads at 4.5:1 on surface-3 (cue-ui-82, 'the smallest moves'). The mockup leaves sunken, the rims, accent-hover, busy, info, stream, selection, the status inks, data-ground and scrim unset: sunken is one step under the page, the rims are quiet greys between the surfaces, accent-hover is the accent lifted, busy, info and stream are cool tints, warn-fg and danger-fg are the page's ink (white on danger is 2.77:1), and data-ground is black, as in every preset.
